Plot a scRhythmDTWHeatmap object

Source: R/plot_dtw_heatmap.R
plot.scRhythmDTWHeatmap.Rd

This S3 method draws a scRhythmDTWHeatmap object returned by plot_dtw_heatmap().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'scRhythmDTWHeatmap'
plot(
  x,
  merge_legends = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  padding = grid::unit(c(6, 4, 4, 4), "mm"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A scRhythmDTWHeatmap object returned by plot_dtw_heatmap().

merge_legends

A logical value indicating whether heatmap and annotation legends should be merged. Defaults to TRUE.

heatmap_legend_side

A character value specifying the heatmap legend side. Defaults to "right".

annotation_legend_side

A character value specifying the annotation legend side. Defaults to "right".

padding

A unit object specifying padding passed to ComplexHeatmap::draw(). Defaults to grid::unit(c(6, 4, 4, 4), "mm").

...

Additional arguments passed to ComplexHeatmap::draw().

Value

Invisibly returns the drawn ComplexHeatmap object.
